Wild-Foraged Wreath-Making Workshop

Sunday, Nov 15, 2026 10:00AM

Montalvo Members: LOG IN 
Members save on this workshop—please log in first to receive your discount.
 

 

Join us for an evening of creativity and camaraderie at The Creekside Studio and create a beautiful locally sourced, seasonal wreath to adorn your home for the winter months or gift to someone special. Whether you are new to this creative art form or experienced, this workshop will provide you with the techniques and wild-foraged materials required to express yourself. All supplies are covered in the workshop fee, which include one wire wreath base, wire, tools, and all the wild-foraged greenery and floral materials needed, right from the Santa Cruz Mountains and Montalvo. And of course, expert help and instruction as you create your custom wreath, sipping a glass of wine amongst old and new friends. We encourage you to bring ribbons or other decorative additions if you wish to add any before you get home. If you have a favorite pruner, please bring it with you.

Super-Secret Holiday Gift-Making Workshop for Youth 

Sunday, Nov 15, 2026 10:00AM

Montalvo Members: LOG IN 
Montalvo Members save on this workshop—log in to access your discount.

Shhh… it’s a secret! In this special two-hour winter workshop, young artists, at any level, will create one-of-a-kind handmade gifts for someone special (it could be you!). From dreaming up their design to making, decorating, and wrapping their finished creation, kids will explore the joy of giving through art.

 
We can tell you that your child will have fun and build artistic confidence in the visual arts with the artist and Montalvo summer camp instructor extraordinaire, Mr. James Green. No matter your student's skill level, each young artist will leave the workshop with two unique gifts, beautifully wrapped and ready to give, with a custom handmade card, no matter their skill level.
 
What will they make? You’ll have to join us to find out! All art materials and supplies are included, and the young artists can enjoy the Art Barn Hot Cocoa Bar while they create.
This workshop is designed for 5–10-year-olds with little to no artistic training. Please send your child to this workshop with the support they need to succeed. For instance, we welcome classroom aids that support your child at school.
